strings.name: Tadashi Yanai
strings.summary: Born in Ube, Yanai entered retail after Waseda and transformed his family’s clothing business. He opened the first Uniqlo in 1984 and pursued global expansion through Fast Retailing. Basic clothing, material development, central purchasing and store management underpin LifeWear. He also funds overseas scholarships and Japanese humanities; early UK expansion required retrenchment.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
